title: Field blocks for Poland
description:
The maximum eligible area (MKO JPO, "maksymalny kwalifikowalny obszar") of Poland's Land Parcel
Identification System, published by the paying agency ARiMR. Poland's reference parcel is the
cadastral parcel; each polygon is the part of one parcel that is eligible for the single area
payment. The layer carries no crop or land-cover class. ARiMR publishes only the current state.

This collection holds 1 edition (2025), one GeoParquet file per year under `year=<year>/` (hive layout). Read them all at once with the partition glob `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/pl_block/year=*/*.parquet` (S3 through the Source Cooperative proxy, endpoint `https://data.source.coop`; plain https cannot expand `*`); the `data` asset is a copy of the latest edition (2025). Geometries are kept in the source CRS (EPSG:2180). Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) into the [fiboa](https://github.com/fiboa/specification) schema; tested queries are in the collection's [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/pl_block/AGENTS.md).

Boundaries are declared: they come from farmers' subsidy applications, or from the parcel register built on those declarations.

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: admin:subdivision_code
table:columns.description: ISO 3166-2 code for the principal subdivision (e.g., province or state, aka admin1) of a country that contains the field. Only the second part of the ISO 3166-2 code is stored. ([spec](https://github.com/vecorel/administrative-division-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: parcel_id
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `id_ewidenc`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

partition:keys.name: year
partition:keys.description: Edition year of the source dataset (the converter variant). Not a column in the files; DuckDB adds it with hive_partitioning=true. Expand the glob through S3 (endpoint data.source.coop, path style); plain https has no listing.

data.title: Poland (blocks) — latest edition (2025) (GeoParquet)
data.description: Byte-identical copy of `year=2025/pl_block.parquet`, kept at a stable path so `*/latest/*.parquet` selects the newest edition of every collection.

style-field-size.title: Field size (ha)
style-field-size.description: Fields shaded light to dark by area in hectares (metrics:area / 10 000). Stops at 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1 ha, the nice values nearest this dataset's 20th/40th/60th/80th percentiles so each class holds a similar share of fields.

style-outline.title: Field boundaries
style-outline.description: Every field in one colour with a thin outline; for reading the boundaries themselves.
